title: CERN 反質子減速器
subcategoryTitle: 大型加速器與光源設施
summary: 以 26 GeV/c 質子打銥靶、在 3.57 GeV/c 收集反質子為起點，理解 AD 如何把它們逐平台減速到 100 MeV/c，再由周長 30.4 m 的 ELENA 降到 100 keV，並把隨機冷卻、電子冷卻、Schottky 診斷、極高真空與效率鏈整合成可交接給 ALPHA、AEgIS、BASE 等實驗的低能反物質工程。
summaryEn: Starting from 26 GeV/c protons on an iridium target and antiproton collection at 3.57 GeV/c, see how the AD decelerates them plateau by plateau to 100 MeV/c and the 30.4 m ELENA ring takes them to 100 keV, then integrate stochastic and electron cooling, Schottky diagnostics, extreme-high vacuum and the efficiency chain into low-energy antimatter engineering handed to experiments such as ALPHA, AEgIS and BASE.
scope: 依公開物理原理與官方資料編寫的原創教學；步驟是可驗證的學習任務與假想算例，不是原廠配方、施工圖、設備操作許可或安全程序。數值均為教學假設，需依實際規格重算。
scopeEn: Original teaching built from public physics and official sources. Steps are verifiable learning tasks and hypothetical exercises, not vendor recipes, construction drawings, operating authorisation or safety procedures. Numbers are teaching assumptions and must be recalculated for real specifications.

labelsEn: PS proton beam and iridium target

architectureNodes: PS proton beam and iridium target

stages.title: 系統邊界與物理原理
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「反質子產生、收集與產額」與「減速、動量與動能及絕熱增長」：先建立機制與定量模型，再設計驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Antiproton production, collection and yield" and "Deceleration, momentum versus kinetic energy and adiabatic growth": build the mechanism and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 反質子產生、收集與產額：原理與系統邊界
steps.titleEn: Antiproton production, collection and yield: mechanism and system boundary
steps.objective: 說明「銥靶與磁喇叭」如何決定CERN 反質子減速器的關鍵性能，並畫出其輸入、輸出與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Iridium target and magnetic horn” determines the key performance of “CERN Antiproton Decelerator”, and map its inputs, outputs and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 反質子無法從自然界取得，只能用高能質子撞擊靶材成對產生。PS 約每 100 s 送出約 1.5×10¹³ 顆 26 GeV 質子，打在長 50 mm 的銥靶上；高密度短靶讓產生點接近點光源，產物向前錐形飛出，再由脈衝磁喇叭的方位角磁場把發散的負電粒子聚焦成近平行束，選取動量約 3.57 GeV/c 的反質子送入周長約 182 m 的 AD。每個質子只換得約百萬分之三的可收集反質子，後續每一步的效率因此都非常珍貴。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「銥靶與磁喇叭」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Antiprotons do not exist in nature and must be pair-produced by high-energy protons striking a target. About every 100 s the PS delivers roughly 1.5×10¹³ protons at 26 GeV onto a 50 mm iridium target; the short, dense target makes the production point nearly a point source, products fly forward in a cone, and the azimuthal field of a pulsed magnetic horn focuses the diverging negative particles into a near-parallel beam from which antiprotons near 3.57 GeV/c are selected for the AD, a ring of about 182 m circumference. Each proton yields only about three collectable antiprotons per million, so every later efficiency is precious. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “Iridium target and magnetic horn”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：p + p → p + p + p + p̄ 的固定靶門檻動能為 6m_pc² ≈ 5.63 GeV，26 GeV 質子遠高於門檻，前向產額在約 3.5 GeV/c 附近最高。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: The fixed-target threshold for p + p → p + p + p + p̄ is a kinetic energy of 6m_pc² ≈ 5.63 GeV, far below 26 GeV, and the forward yield peaks near 3.5 GeV/c.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「反質子一離開靶就已經夠冷，實驗可以直接捕捉。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在方塊圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Antiprotons leave the target cold enough for experiments to trap directly." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your block diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 方塊圖標明「銥靶與磁喇叭」的輸入、輸出與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The block diagram shows inputs, outputs and boundaries of “Iridium target and magnetic horn”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 反質子產生、收集與產額
knowledge.text: 反質子無法從自然界取得，只能用高能質子撞擊靶材成對產生。PS 約每 100 s 送出約 1.5×10¹³ 顆 26 GeV 質子，打在長 50 mm 的銥靶上；高密度短靶讓產生點接近點光源，產物向前錐形飛出，再由脈衝磁喇叭的方位角磁場把發散的負電粒子聚焦成近平行束，選取動量約 3.57 GeV/c 的反質子送入周長約 182 m 的 AD。
knowledge.textEn: Antiprotons do not exist in nature and must be pair-produced by high-energy protons striking a target. About every 100 s the PS delivers roughly 1.5×10¹³ protons at 26 GeV onto a 50 mm iridium target; the short, dense target makes the production point nearly a point source, products fly forward in a cone, and the azimuthal field of a pulsed magnetic horn focuses the diverging negative particles into a near-parallel beam from which antiprotons near 3.57 GeV/c are selected for the AD, a ring of about 182 m circumference.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：反質子一離開靶就已經夠冷，實驗可以直接捕捉。 正確的工程判斷必須回到機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Antiprotons leave the target cold enough for experiments to trap directly. Sound engineering judgement goes back to mechanism and magnitude.

knowledge.title: 任務延伸｜遊戲交班延伸：先界定介面
knowledge.titleEn: Mission extension | Campaign transfer: define interfaces first
knowledge.text:
本課「CERN 反質子減速器」的「反質子產生、收集與產額：原理與系統邊界」是這項延伸任務的檢核點。 畫出試件、激發、光路或訊號路徑與讀出的邊界，在每條箭頭旁寫量、單位、正方向與資料版本。再打開「大型儀器：校正交班日」，比較哪一個介面可類比、哪一個不可類比；不可因為畫面相似就共用數值參數。

需留下的證據：提交一張介面圖與校正件識別、暗場或零點、原始訊號與取樣設定的欄位樣本；將假設值、來源值與本次實測值分欄。

驗證與交接：每個介面至少有一個可核對量；提出一項能讓模型失效的邊界改變，而不是只重述公式。
knowledge.textEn:
The checkpoint is “Antiproton production, collection and yield: mechanism and system boundary” in “CERN Antiproton Decelerator”. Draw the specimen, excitation, optical/signal path and readout boundaries; label quantities, units, sign conventions and data revisions on each arrow. Open “Large Instruments: Calibration Handoff” and identify which interfaces transfer and which do not. Similar-looking scenes do not justify shared numerical parameters.

Evidence to retain: Submit an interface diagram and sample fields for reference-artifact identity, dark/zero records, raw signals and sampling settings, separating assumed, sourced and newly measured values.

Verification and handover: Each interface has a checkable quantity. Identify one boundary change that invalidates the model instead of merely repeating a formula.

quiz.question: 關於「反質子產生、收集與產額」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Antiproton production, collection and yield" is correct?
options: 反質子一離開靶就已經夠冷，實驗可以直接捕捉。
反質子無法從自然界取得，只能用高能質子撞擊靶材成對產生。
動量為 100 MeV/c 的反質子，它的動能也就是 100 MeV。
optionsEn: Antiprotons leave the target cold enough for experiments to trap directly.
Antiprotons do not exist in nature and must be pair-produced by high-energy protons striking a target.
An antiproton at 100 MeV/c has 100 MeV of kinetic energy.
quiz.explanation: 反質子無法從自然界取得，只能用高能質子撞擊靶材成對產生。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Antiprotons do not exist in nature and must be pair-produced by high-energy protons striking a target. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 反質子產生、收集與產額：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Antiproton production, collection and yield: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「銥靶與磁喇叭」的關鍵量，並判斷參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Iridium target and magnetic horn” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of changes when a parameter moves.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：p + p → p + p + p + p̄ 的固定靶門檻動能為 6m_pc² ≈ 5.63 GeV，26 GeV 質子遠高於門檻，前向產額在約 3.5 GeV/c 附近最高。產額：注入 AD 約 5×10⁷ 顆 ÷ 1.5×10¹³ 顆質子 ≈ 3.3×10⁻⁶。磁喇叭假設電流 400 kA，半徑 2 cm 處 B = μ₀I/(2πr) = 4 T，對 Bρ = 11.9 T·m 的 3.57 GeV/c 粒子提供強聚焦。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: The fixed-target threshold for p + p → p + p + p + p̄ is a kinetic energy of 6m_pc² ≈ 5.63 GeV, far below 26 GeV, and the forward yield peaks near 3.5 GeV/c. Yield: about 5×10⁷ antiprotons injected into the AD ÷ 1.5×10¹³ protons ≈ 3.3×10⁻⁶. Assuming a 400 kA horn current, the field at r = 2 cm is B = μ₀I/(2πr) = 4 T, strong focusing for 3.57 GeV/c particles with Bρ = 11.9 T·m. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, and state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper.
steps.observation: 如何核對：以注入線束流變壓器與 AD 環內的 Schottky 訊號量測每循環捕獲的反質子數，除以打靶質子數求產額；掃描靶上束流位置、喇叭電流與注入線動量設定，找出最大產額並與模擬產額曲線比較；長期記錄產額對靶累積劑量的變化。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Measure the antiprotons captured per cycle with injection-line transformers and the ring's Schottky signal and divide by the protons on target to obtain the yield; scan beam position on the target, horn current and injection-line momentum to find the maximum and compare with simulated yield curves; log yield against accumulated target dose over the long term.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成設備規格，或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit conversion slips, treating teaching assumptions as equipment specifications, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與物理解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with a physical explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: p + p → p + p + p + p̄ 的固定靶門檻動能為 6m_pc² ≈ 5.63 GeV，26 GeV 質子遠高於門檻，前向產額在約 3.5 GeV/c 附近最高。產額：注入 AD 約 5×10⁷ 顆 ÷ 1.5×10¹³ 顆質子 ≈ 3.3×10⁻⁶。磁喇叭假設電流 400 kA，半徑 2 cm 處 B = μ₀I/(2πr) = 4 T，對 Bρ = 11.9 T·m 的 3.57 GeV/c 粒子提供強聚焦。
knowledge.textEn: The fixed-target threshold for p + p → p + p + p + p̄ is a kinetic energy of 6m_pc² ≈ 5.63 GeV, far below 26 GeV, and the forward yield peaks near 3.5 GeV/c. Yield: about 5×10⁷ antiprotons injected into the AD ÷ 1.5×10¹³ protons ≈ 3.3×10⁻⁶. Assuming a 400 kA horn current, the field at r = 2 cm is B = μ₀I/(2πr) = 4 T, strong focusing for 3.57 GeV/c particles with Bρ = 11.9 T·m.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設；套用到實際設備前，必須重新取得規格、操作條件與不確定度。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions; before applying them to real equipment, obtain the actual specifications, operating conditions and uncertainties.

quiz.question: 依「反質子產生、收集與產額」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Antiproton production, collection and yield", which statement holds?
options: 電子冷卻在任何能量都優於隨機冷卻，AD 全程都該使用。
反質子只會與物質湮滅，殘氣散射對壽命沒有影響。
p + p → p + p + p + p̄ 的固定靶門檻動能為 6m_pc² ≈ 5.63 GeV，26 GeV 質子遠高於門檻，前向產額在約 3.5 GeV/c 附近最高。
optionsEn: Electron cooling beats stochastic cooling at every energy, so the AD should use it throughout.
Antiprotons are lost only by annihilation, so residual-gas scattering does not affect lifetime.
The fixed-target threshold for p + p → p + p + p + p̄ is a kinetic energy of 6m_pc² ≈ 5.63 GeV, far below 26 GeV, and the forward yield peaks near 3.5 GeV/c.
quiz.explanation: p + p → p + p + p + p̄ 的固定靶門檻動能為 6m_pc² ≈ 5.63 GeV，26 GeV 質子遠高於門檻，前向產額在約 3.5 GeV/c 附近最高。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: The fixed-target threshold for p + p → p + p + p + p̄ is a kinetic energy of 6m_pc² ≈ 5.63 GeV, far below 26 GeV, and the forward yield peaks near 3.5 GeV/c. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 反質子產生、收集與產額：量測與驗證
steps.titleEn: Antiproton production, collection and yield: measurement and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的量測，驗證「銥靶與磁喇叭」是否符合模型預期，並訂出允收準則。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable measurement that verifies whether “Iridium target and magnetic horn” meets the model expectation, and set acceptance criteria.
steps.instruction: 以注入線束流變壓器與 AD 環內的 Schottky 訊號量測每循環捕獲的反質子數，除以打靶質子數求產額；掃描靶上束流位置、喇叭電流與注入線動量設定，找出最大產額並與模擬產額曲線比較；長期記錄產額對靶累積劑量的變化。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成量測計畫，列出儀器、基準件或參考樣品、步驟、比較對象與允收準則，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Measure the antiprotons captured per cycle with injection-line transformers and the ring's Schottky signal and divide by the protons on target to obtain the yield; scan beam position on the target, horn current and injection-line momentum to find the maximum and compare with simulated yield curves; log yield against accumulated target dose over the long term. Mentor task: turn this into a measurement plan listing instruments, reference artefacts or samples, procedure, comparison baseline and acceptance criteria, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 注意干擾：靶材在多年脈衝熱衝擊下出現內部裂紋與密度降低，或質子束點偏離靶心，產額逐漸下降 10–30% 而不易察覺；磁喇叭導體疲勞斷裂則使聚焦消失，捕獲數驟降到原本的一小部分，所有反物質實驗同時停擺。
steps.observationEn: Watch for interference: Years of pulsed thermal shock crack the target internally and lower its density, or the proton spot drifts off centre, and the yield sinks by 10–30% unnoticed; a fatigue fracture in the horn conductor removes the focusing, capture collapses to a small fraction of normal, and every antimatter experiment stops at once.
steps.failure: 驗證陷阱：只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄環境條件，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Verification traps: a single measurement, no traceable reference, or unrecorded environmental conditions make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格。
steps.checkEn: Submit the measurement plan: instruments, reference, procedure, acceptance criteria and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail decision rule.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 以注入線束流變壓器與 AD 環內的 Schottky 訊號量測每循環捕獲的反質子數，除以打靶質子數求產額；掃描靶上束流位置、喇叭電流與注入線動量設定，找出最大產額並與模擬產額曲線比較；長期記錄產額對靶累積劑量的變化。
knowledge.textEn: Measure the antiprotons captured per cycle with injection-line transformers and the ring's Schottky signal and divide by the protons on target to obtain the yield; scan beam position on the target, horn current and injection-line momentum to find the maximum and compare with simulated yield curves; log yield against accumulated target dose over the long term.

knowledge.title: 允收與不確定度
knowledge.text: 允收準則必須在量測前訂定，並與擴充不確定度一起陳述；比較基準需可追溯。
knowledge.textEn: Acceptance criteria are fixed before measuring and stated together with expanded uncertainty; the comparison reference must be traceable.

quiz.question: 要驗證「反質子產生、收集與產額」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Antiproton production, collection and yield"?
options: 以注入線束流變壓器與 AD 環內的 Schottky 訊號量測每循環捕獲的反質子數，除以打靶質子數求產額。
量測時不必記錄溫度、振動與時間等條件，因為它們不會影響結果。
ELENA 只是再降低能量，並不會增加實驗可用的反質子數。
optionsEn: Measure the antiprotons captured per cycle with injection-line transformers and the ring's Schottky signal and divide by the protons on target to obtain the yield.
Temperature, vibration and timing need not be recorded because they cannot affect the result.
ELENA merely lowers the energy further and does not increase usable antiprotons.
quiz.explanation: 以注入線束流變壓器與 AD 環內的 Schottky 訊號量測每循環捕獲的反質子數，除以打靶質子數求產額；掃描靶上束流位置、喇叭電流與注入線動量設定，找出最大產額並與模擬產額曲線比較；長期記錄產額對靶累積劑量的變化。 驗證需要基準、重複性與允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Measure the antiprotons captured per cycle with injection-line transformers and the ring's Schottky signal and divide by the protons on target to obtain the yield; scan beam position on the target, horn current and injection-line momentum to find the maximum and compare with simulated yield curves; log yield against accumulated target dose over the long term. Verification needs a reference, repeatability and acceptance criteria.

steps.title: 反質子產生、收集與產額：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Antiproton production, collection and yield: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「銥靶與磁喇叭」的失效原因，提出能區分原因的檢查與矯正措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure causes of “Iridium target and magnetic horn” and propose discriminating checks and corrective actions.
steps.instruction: 靶材在多年脈衝熱衝擊下出現內部裂紋與密度降低，或質子束點偏離靶心，產額逐漸下降 10–30% 而不易察覺；磁喇叭導體疲勞斷裂則使聚焦消失，捕獲數驟降到原本的一小部分，所有反物質實驗同時停擺。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整個系統的性能、良率或安全。
steps.instructionEn: Years of pulsed thermal shock crack the target internally and lower its density, or the proton spot drifts off centre, and the yield sinks by 10–30% unnoticed; a fatigue fracture in the horn conductor removes the focusing, capture collapses to a small fraction of normal, and every antimatter experiment stops at once. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-system performance, yield or safety.
steps.observation: 連結機制：每個質子只換得約百萬分之三的可收集反質子，後續每一步的效率因此都非常珍貴。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Each proton yields only about three collectable antiprotons per million, so every later efficiency is precious.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「反質子一離開靶就已經夠冷，實驗可以直接捕捉。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Antiprotons leave the target cold enough for experiments to trap directly." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，並指出哪一項量測能最快確認根因、如何防止再發。

knowledge.title: 失效模式

steps.title: 減速、動量與動能及絕熱增長：原理與系統邊界
steps.titleEn: Deceleration, momentum versus kinetic energy and adiabatic growth: mechanism and system boundary
steps.objective: 說明「動量平台 3.57→0.1 GeV/c」如何決定CERN 反質子減速器的關鍵性能，並畫出其輸入、輸出與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Momentum plateaus 3.57→0.1 GeV/c” determines the key performance of “CERN Antiproton Decelerator”, and map its inputs, outputs and boundaries.
steps.instruction: AD 是倒著運轉的同步加速器：磁場與射頻頻率同步下降，把反質子由 3.57 GeV/c 依序減到 2 GeV/c、300 MeV/c 與 100 MeV/c。加速器以動量描述粒子，因為磁剛度 Bρ 正比於動量；實驗端則關心動能。減速時幾何發射度按 1/(βγ) 反向增長、相對動量分散也變大，就像加速時的絕熱阻尼倒過來；若不在平台上冷卻，束流會在減速途中撐滿孔徑而流失。射頻系統還必須追蹤速度由 0.97c 降到 0.1c 的大幅頻率變化。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「動量平台 3.57→0.1 GeV/c」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: The AD is a synchrotron run in reverse: field and RF frequency fall together, taking antiprotons from 3.57 GeV/c to 2 GeV/c, 300 MeV/c and 100 MeV/c. Accelerator physicists describe particles by momentum because magnetic rigidity Bρ is proportional to it, while experiments care about kinetic energy. During deceleration geometric emittance grows as 1/(βγ) and relative momentum spread widens, adiabatic damping run backwards; without cooling on the plateaus the beam would fill the aperture and be lost on the way down. The RF system must also follow the large frequency swing as speed drops from 0.97c to 0.1c. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “Momentum plateaus 3.57→0.1 GeV/c”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: At 3.57 GeV/c, E = √(3.57² + 0.938²) = 3.691 GeV, kinetic energy 2.75 GeV and β = 0.967; at 100 MeV/c the kinetic energy is 5.31 MeV and β = 0.106.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「動量為 100 MeV/c 的反質子，它的動能也就是 100 MeV。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在方塊圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "An antiproton at 100 MeV/c has 100 MeV of kinetic energy." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your block diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 方塊圖標明「動量平台 3.57→0.1 GeV/c」的輸入、輸出與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The block diagram shows inputs, outputs and boundaries of “Momentum plateaus 3.57→0.1 GeV/c”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

steps.title: 減速、動量與動能及絕熱增長：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Deceleration, momentum versus kinetic energy and adiabatic growth: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「動量平台 3.57→0.1 GeV/c」的關鍵量，並判斷參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Momentum plateaus 3.57→0.1 GeV/c” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of changes when a parameter moves.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：3.57 GeV/c：E = √(3.57² + 0.938²) = 3.691 GeV，動能 2.75 GeV，β = 0.967；100 MeV/c：動能 5.31 MeV，β = 0.106。βγ 比 = 3.805/0.1066 ≈ 35.7，不冷卻時 5 π mm·mrad 會長到約 179 π mm·mrad。Bρ 由 11.91 降到 0.334 T·m；周長 182.4 m 時迴轉頻率由 1.59 MHz 降到 0.174 MHz，射頻須涵蓋約 9:1 的頻率範圍。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: At 3.57 GeV/c, E = √(3.57² + 0.938²) = 3.691 GeV, kinetic energy 2.75 GeV and β = 0.967; at 100 MeV/c the kinetic energy is 5.31 MeV and β = 0.106. The βγ ratio is 3.805/0.1066 ≈ 35.7, so without cooling 5 π mm·mrad would grow to about 179 π mm·mrad. Bρ falls from 11.91 to 0.334 T·m, and for a 182.4 m circumference the revolution frequency falls from 1.59 MHz to 0.174 MHz, so the RF must span about 9:1 in frequency. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, and state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper.
steps.observation: 如何核對：在每個平台以 Schottky 頻譜量測動量分散與強度、以掃描器量測發射度，與 βγ 標度預測比較；記錄磁場與射頻頻率程式的對應，在平台上微調射頻頻率檢查平均徑向位置是否置中，以此量化磁場—頻率追蹤誤差。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: On each plateau measure momentum spread and intensity from the Schottky spectrum and emittance with scanners, comparing with the βγ scaling; log the field and RF-frequency programmes side by side and trim the RF frequency on the plateau to check that the mean radial position is centred, quantifying the field–frequency tracking error.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成設備規格，或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit conversion slips, treating teaching assumptions as equipment specifications, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與物理解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with a physical explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型

The βγ ratio is 3.805/0.1066 ≈ 35.7, so without cooling 5 π mm·mrad would grow to about 179 π mm·mrad. Bρ falls from 11.91 to 0.334 T·m, and for a 182.4 m circumference the revolution frequency falls from 1.59 MHz to 0.174 MHz, so the RF must span about 9:1 in frequency.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設；套用到實際設備前，必須重新取得規格、操作條件與不確定度。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions; before applying them to real equipment, obtain the actual specifications, operating conditions and uncertainties.

steps.title: 減速、動量與動能及絕熱增長：量測與驗證
steps.titleEn: Deceleration, momentum versus kinetic energy and adiabatic growth: measurement and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的量測，驗證「動量平台 3.57→0.1 GeV/c」是否符合模型預期，並訂出允收準則。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable measurement that verifies whether “Momentum plateaus 3.57→0.1 GeV/c” meets the model expectation, and set acceptance criteria.
steps.instruction: 在每個平台以 Schottky 頻譜量測動量分散與強度、以掃描器量測發射度，與 βγ 標度預測比較；記錄磁場與射頻頻率程式的對應，在平台上微調射頻頻率檢查平均徑向位置是否置中，以此量化磁場—頻率追蹤誤差。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成量測計畫，列出儀器、基準件或參考樣品、步驟、比較對象與允收準則，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: On each plateau measure momentum spread and intensity from the Schottky spectrum and emittance with scanners, comparing with the βγ scaling; log the field and RF-frequency programmes side by side and trim the RF frequency on the plateau to check that the mean radial position is centred, quantifying the field–frequency tracking error. Mentor task: turn this into a measurement plan listing instruments, reference artefacts or samples, procedure, comparison baseline and acceptance criteria, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 注意干擾：射頻頻率程式與實際磁場在低動量端有 10⁻³ 的追蹤誤差時，束流徑向偏到色散大的位置刮到孔徑，或在減速段逐步流失；低場時剩磁與渦電流的相對影響變大，常是 100 MeV/c 平台損失的根源。
steps.observationEn: Watch for interference: A 10⁻³ tracking error between the RF programme and the real field at low momentum pushes the beam radially into high-dispersion regions where it scrapes, or bleeds it away during the ramp down; at low field remanence and eddy currents matter relatively more and often cause losses on the 100 MeV/c plateau.
steps.failure: 驗證陷阱：只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄環境條件，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Verification traps: a single measurement, no traceable reference, or unrecorded environmental conditions make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格。
steps.checkEn: Submit the measurement plan: instruments, reference, procedure, acceptance criteria and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail decision rule.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 在每個平台以 Schottky 頻譜量測動量分散與強度、以掃描器量測發射度，與 βγ 標度預測比較；記錄磁場與射頻頻率程式的對應，在平台上微調射頻頻率檢查平均徑向位置是否置中，以此量化磁場—頻率追蹤誤差。

knowledge.text: 允收準則必須在量測前訂定，並與擴充不確定度一起陳述；比較基準需可追溯。
knowledge.textEn: Acceptance criteria are fixed before measuring and stated together with expanded uncertainty; the comparison reference must be traceable.

options: 調高增益或放寬允收值，就能解決大多數異常。
隨機冷卻是對每一顆反質子分別做精準修正。
射頻頻率程式與實際磁場在低動量端有 10⁻³ 的追蹤誤差時，束流徑向偏到色散大的位置刮到孔徑，或在減速段逐步流失。
optionsEn: Raising the gain or widening the acceptance limits solves most anomalies.
Stochastic cooling corrects each antiproton individually.
A 10⁻³ tracking error between the RF programme and the real field at low momentum pushes the beam radially into high-dispersion regions where it scrapes, or bleeds it away during the ramp down.
quiz.explanation: 射頻頻率程式與實際磁場在低動量端有 10⁻³ 的追蹤誤差時，束流徑向偏到色散大的位置刮到孔徑，或在減速段逐步流失；低場時剩磁與渦電流的相對影響變大，常是 100 MeV/c 平台損失的根源。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: A 10⁻³ tracking error between the RF programme and the real field at low momentum pushes the beam radially into high-dispersion regions where it scrapes, or bleeds it away during the ramp down; at low field remanence and eddy currents matter relatively more and often cause losses on the 100 MeV/c plateau. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.
